# BEZALEL INC — Complete Institutional Profile & Knowledge Base

## Overview
- Entity Name: BEZALEL INC (BEZALEL INC Group)
- Established: 2008
- Headquarters: Malaysia & Singapore (Serving Southeast Asia)
- Core Motto: "Equip people. Strengthen enterprise. Multiply opportunity."
- Official Website: https://bezalelinc.com
- Primary Direct Desk: connect@bezalelinc.com

## What is BEZALEL INC?
BEZALEL INC is an integrated stewardship and enterprise development ecosystem. Rather than offering transactional consulting, the group combines psychological and relational wellbeing, executive leadership formation, brand architecture, and corporate governance into one unified ecosystem. 

## The Biblical Foundation (Exodus 31:1-6)
BEZALEL takes its name and ethos from Bezalel in Exodus 31:1-6, whom God called by name and filled with the Spirit of God in wisdom (hokhmah), understanding (tevunah), knowledge (da'at), and all kinds of craftsmanship (melakhah) to design and execute enduring works with integrity and precision. This ethos translates into enduring fiduciary stewardship, human dignity, and architectural excellence across all ventures.

## The Four Operating Ventures

### 1. Olive & Vine — Psychological & Relational Care (Entity 01)
- Focus: Mental health, relational restorative care, individual and family psychological therapy, school wellbeing frameworks, corporate emotional health advisory.
- Key Capabilities: Licensed clinical therapy, burnout recovery, trauma-informed mediation, emotional wellbeing curricula for educators and students.
- Accent Color: Olive / Sage (#8C9E5E)
- URL: https://bezalelinc.com/ecosystem#olive-vine

### 2. HUR-ON — Corporate Training & Consultancy (Entity 02)
- Focus: Executive leadership development, organizational human capital formation, experiential leadership retreats, team alignment, succession capability.
- Key Capabilities: High-stakes board facilitation, C-suite leadership development, custom organizational simulations, culture change stewardship.
- Accent Color: Rich Forest (#405329)
- URL: https://bezalelinc.com/ecosystem#hur-on

### 3. Mustard Seed & Co — Creative & Brand Growth (Entity 03)
- Focus: Brand narrative architecture, creative communications, digital experience design, positioning strategy.
- Key Capabilities: Strategic positioning, identity design, visual storytelling, stakeholder communication frameworks, product launch strategy.
- Accent Color: Warm Ochre (#C28D3E)
- URL: https://bezalelinc.com/ecosystem#mustard-seed

### 4. Phroneo BoardSuite — Corporate Governance & Secretarial (Entity 04)
- Focus: Corporate secretarial compliance, statutory filing, board governance advisory, institutional structuring, risk mitigation.
- Key Capabilities: Company secretarial governance, board stewardship charters, regulatory compliance, corporate restructuring advisory.
- Accent Color: Deep Midnight (#1D2B3A)
- URL: https://bezalelinc.com/ecosystem#phroneo

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: How does BEZALEL INC differ from traditional consulting firms?
A: Traditional consulting isolates services—corporate legal, human resources, marketing, and therapy operate in separate silos. BEZALEL INC integrates these four practices under one biblical and ethical stewardship standard, ensuring that human wellbeing, business structure, public branding, and board governance reinforce one another.

Q: Can an organization engage a single venture or must they engage the entire group?
A: Organizations can engage any single operating venture (such as Olive & Vine for school wellbeing or HUR-ON for executive training), or initiate cross-venture group stewardship for enterprise-wide transformation.

Q: Where does BEZALEL INC operate?
A: While based in Malaysia and Singapore, BEZALEL INC operates regional programs and leadership retreats across Southeast Asia and internationally.

Q: How can prospective partners get in touch?
A: Inquiries can be submitted directly through https://bezalelinc.com/inquire or by emailing connect@bezalelinc.com.
